note_text:
CC: follow up plantar fasciitis

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to multiple thickened painful nails. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Exam: nails examined consistent with multiple thickened painful nails; no other findings recorded.

MDM: addressed the procedure as well as a separate complaint; considered conservative options for the separate complaint and deferred a decision.

Procedure: Debridement of 6 or more thickened nails performed with sterile technique (RT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
